## The problem

What you were doing, and where agentille got in the way or fell short. One concrete case beats a general wish.

## What you would like

The behaviour you want, in terms of what you type and what you see.

## What it would touch

Tick what you think the change needs. A guess is fine.

- [ ] The `/agt` skill (`skills/agt/`)
- [ ] An agent definition (`agents/`)
- [ ] The mod (`hooks/`): what is drawn, routing, panes or guards
- [ ] A `~/.agentille/profile.json` key
- [ ] Docs only

## Alternatives you tried

Settings, flags or plain prompts that came close.
